name: I2C bus header with pull-ups
description: A four-pin I2C header with a pull-up resistor on SDA and SCL.

parameters.name: connectorRef
parameters.description: Reference designator for the bus header.

parameters.name: sdaRef
parameters.description: Reference designator for the SDA pull-up.

parameters.name: sclRef
parameters.description: Reference designator for the SCL pull-up.

parameters.name: pcbX
parameters.description: Module position on the board, in millimetres.

parameters.name: pcbY
parameters.description: Module position on the board, in millimetres.

parameters.name: schX
parameters.description: Module position on the schematic sheet.

parameters.name: schY
parameters.description: Module position on the schematic sheet.

notes: One pull-up pair per bus: adding this module twice on one bus halves the pull-up resistance.
4.7k suits a 100 kHz bus with light capacitance. Faster buses or longer traces need lower values.
The header uses the built-in pinrow4 footprint, which a build may report as differing from the supplier footprint.
